description: Maps four trigger inputs onto sixteen outputs a step at a time, following a pattern, with 64 stored scenes.

params.text: Chooses which of the 64 stored scenes is playing; a cable in the scene input takes this over.
Sends every track back to the start of its pattern.
Stops the pattern once it has finished, so nothing triggers again until a reset.
Restarts every track once the track with the most steps has reached its end.
Restarts every track once all four tracks have reached their ends.
Restarts each track on its own as soon as that track reaches its end.

inputs.text: Chooses the scene from a voltage, 0-10V spanning all 64, and overrides the scene knob while patched.
A trigger here advances that track one step and fires the output written at the step it lands on.
A trigger here sends every track back to the start of its pattern.
A trigger here moves every pattern up one track, and the top track's pattern wraps round to the bottom.
A trigger here moves every pattern down one track, and the bottom track's pattern wraps round to the top.
A trigger here reverses the order of the four tracks, so the first and last swap patterns and so do the middle two.
A trigger here reverses each track's pattern end to end.

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V trigger whenever a step names this output number.
A 1ms 10V pulse when the pattern reaches its end under the repeat mode in use.

notes: click a box in the grid and drag up or down to set which output that step fires; work from the left, because the first empty box ends that track.
a track with no boxes drawn sends nothing, so draw at least one box for a track before triggering its input.
